eas_text: A civil authority has issued A LOCAL AREA EMERGENCY for the following counties or areas: Valley, ID; at 7:15 PM on AUG 31, 2025 Effective until 8:15 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: This is the Valley County Sheriff's Office with an emergency alert. We are currently searching for a missing 15-year-old male named Anthony in the Donnelly area. He is 5'9" and 120 pounds. He has blonde hair. He is wearing a green shirt, black sweatpants, tan socks, and hiking boots. If you see someone matching his description, please contact Valley County Dispatch at 208-382-5160.
